subject: Discovery summary & milestones for GenAssist pilot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Louis Park <louis@acrosshealth.co>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery summary & milestones for GenAssist pilot

Hi Louis / Anika —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and a proposed set of milestones so we’re aligned on next steps. I kept this short so your engineering and product teams can skim.

Key pain points you shared
- Search/assist latency varies with peak traffic; users see timeouts at ~100 concurrent requests.
- Cost unpredictability with current third-party billing model.
- Need for on-prem / VPC routing for PHI-sensitive workloads (HIPAA constraints).

Current stack (what you told us)
- Backend: Node.js microservices (Koa).
- DB: ElasticSearch for vector search + Postgres for metadata.
- Hosting: GCP us-central with a private VPC; strict egress controls.

Success criteria for a pilot (proposed, please edit)
1) Performance: p95 < 200ms for text-generation flows at sustained 50 req/s (alpha traffic profile).
2) Retrieval quality: embedding + reranker achieves >= 0.85 relevance on your seed eval set.
3) Security: VPC-connect + SOC2/HIPAA attestation for the pilot environment.
4) Ops: no more than 1% error rate and observability into token costs per route.

Integration & compatibility notes
- SDKs we offer: Node.js, Python, Go. We will provide a minimal Node sample that mirrors your Koa flow.
- API compatibility: REST + OpenAI-compatible chat/generation endpoints; we support streaming and function/tool style payloads.
- KV cache support: prefix caching and configurable TTLs (we can show a sample strategy for your analytics path).

Proposed milestones & owners (4-week alpha pilot)
- Week 0 (this week): NDA + sign SOW, environment access (Louis/Anika + Sean) — Owner: Sean
- Week 1: Node SDK drop + example ingestion pipeline (vectors -> ES) — Owner: Rishi
- Week 2: Integration smoke tests, basic eval on seed prompts — Owners: Across Eng + Rishi
- Week 3: Performance tuning, batching/caching rules, run 1k synthetic load test — Owner: Redwood infra team (coord via Sean)
- Week 4: Success criteria validation, go/no-go decision and next-step pricing discussion — Owners: Louis + Sean

Attachments: I’ve attached a short demo agenda and our integration assumptions doc.

Ask / next meetings
- Can we lock a 45m technical demo + Q&A for next Tue or Wed? I included two options below — pick one and I’ll calendar it.
  * Wed 12/16 10:00–10:45 PT
  * Tue 12/15 14:00–14:45 PT

If this looks good I’ll: (1) send an SOW draft, (2) drop the Node SDK sample, and (3) provision a temporary VPC-friendly demo stack.

Thanks — appreciate the candid conversation today.

—
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Louis Park <louis@acrosshealth.co>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Anika Shah <anika.shah@acrosshealth.co>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery summary & milestones for GenAssist pilot

Thanks Sean — this is very clear and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 50 req/s number is conservative; our expected peak for the pilot is closer to 120 concurrent short chat requests (100–300 token responses). Can you confirm the performance target scales linearly or if you recommend a different configuration?
- HIPAA: we need written confirmation that the Private/VPC path will support encrypted egress and KMS integration for key management (our security team will want a short list of artifacts).
- Caching: we currently use a small local KV store (Redis). Would Redwood’s prefix caching layer accept our TTLs and play nicely with Redis?

Also, please include a short Node snippet (30–40 lines) that shows how we would call your streaming generation endpoint and how to attach a user_id for traceability. That will help our engs estimate work.

We prefer Wed 12/16 10:00 PT for the demo. If you can send a calendar invite to the group I’ll make sure engineering and security attend.

Thanks — Louis
Louis Park
Head of Product, Across Health
louis@acrosshealth.co | +1 (617) 555-9876

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Across Health pilot — action list

Quick internal note following Louis’s reply. Agreed items and owners below so we don’t miss anything.

Action items
- Rishi: produce a 30–40 line Node SDK example that demonstrates streaming generation + user_id propagation + attaching a request_id header. Also include a short snippet showing how to toggle prefix caching for a given route. Due: Fri 12/11 EOD.
- Sean: send SOW draft, calendar invite for Wed 12/16 10:00 PT, and request initial security artifacts (SOC2/HIPAA scope, KMS diagram). Due: Thu 12/10.
- Priya: prepare a short one-pager on pricing for the 4-week pilot (including a pilot credit / modest discount). Draft due: Mon 12/14.

Notes / clarifications
- On scale: they expect ~120 concurrent short chat requests during pilot; we should recommend a conservative infra buffer and propose autoscale thresholds.
- Security ask: include KMS integration and encryption-in-transit + at-rest language in the SOW; capture follow-up evidence items in the Drive folder (I created a stub and added the integration-assumptions.md).

I’ll sync with legal on the SOW language around HIPAA. Rishi — flag here if you need a live environment to test the snippet.

— Priya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
